concepts.title: 旋转坐标轴
concepts.summary: 坐标轴逆时针旋转，曲线本身不动。
pitfalls: 不要把旋转坐标轴误作旋转曲线。

en.title: Rotation of axes
en.summary: The coordinate axes rotate counterclockwise; the curve itself remains fixed.
pitfalls: Do not confuse a rotation of axes with a rotation of the curve.

concepts.title: 分类与退化检查
concepts.summary: 非退化时看 $B^2-4AC$，再配方验证实点。

method.title: 方法
method.body: $B^2-4AC=0,<0,>0$ 分别对应抛物线、椭圆型、双曲线型；可能退化为点、线或空集。

en.title: Classification and degeneracy
en.summary: For a nondegenerate conic use $B^2-4AC$, then complete squares to verify real points.

method.title: Method
method.body: $B^2-4AC=0,<0,>0$ correspond to parabolic, elliptic, and hyperbolic types; degeneracy may give points, lines, or the empty set.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (a) 配方得到 $5 x^{2} = 2 y - 7$，因此实际实点图像为抛物线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (b) 配方得到 $7 \left(x - \frac{3}{14}\right)^{2} - 4 \left(y - 1\right)^{2} = \frac{233}{28}$，因此实际实点图像为双曲线。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: (c) 配方得到 $2 y^{2} + 3 \left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} = - \frac{33}{4}$，因此实际实点图像为空集（无实点）。

questions.answer: (a) 抛物线；$5 x^{2} = 2 y - 7$；(b) 双曲线；$7 \left(x - \frac{3}{14}\right)^{2} - 4 \left(y - 1\right)^{2} = \frac{233}{28}$；(c) 空集（无实点）；$2 y^{2} + 3 \left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} = - \frac{33}{4}$ 原书(c)称为椭圆，但配方后左边非负而右边为负，实际为空集。

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (a) Completing squares gives $5 x^{2} = 2 y - 7$, so the actual real graph is a parabola.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (b) Completing squares gives $7 \left(x - \frac{3}{14}\right)^{2} - 4 \left(y - 1\right)^{2} = \frac{233}{28}$, so the actual real graph is a hyperbola.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: (c) Completing squares gives $2 y^{2} + 3 \left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} = - \frac{33}{4}$, so the actual real graph is the empty set (no real points).

en.answer: (a) a parabola; $5 x^{2} = 2 y - 7$; (b) a hyperbola; $7 \left(x - \frac{3}{14}\right)^{2} - 4 \left(y - 1\right)^{2} = \frac{233}{28}$; (c) the empty set (no real points); $2 y^{2} + 3 \left(x - \frac{1}{2}\right)^{2} = - \frac{33}{4}$ The book calls (c) an ellipse, but the completed equation has a nonnegative left side and a negative right side; its real graph is empty.

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: $x'=x\cos\theta+y\sin\theta$，$y'=-x\sin\theta+y\cos\theta$。

steps.title: 计算与推导

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: $x'=x\cos\theta+y\sin\theta$ and $y'=-x\sin\theta+y\cos\theta$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason

questions.label: 例题 2

questions.prompt: 将坐标轴旋转 $45^\circ$，用新坐标表示 $x y = 1$ 并作图。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 取 $\cot(2\theta)=(A-C)/B$，并在 $0<2\theta<180^\circ$ 内选择角度（半角均取正），得 $\cos\theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\ \sin\theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 再配方得到 $\frac{x'^{2}}{2} - \frac{y'^{2}}{2} = 1$。因此图像为双曲线。坐标轴旋转而原平面曲线保持不动。

en.prompt: Rotate the coordinate axes through $45^\circ$, express $x y = 1$ in the new coordinates, and sketch the graph.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use $\cot(2\theta)=(A-C)/B$ and select $0<2\theta<180^\circ$; both half-angle values are positive. Thus $\cos\theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2},\ \sin\theta=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute $x=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}x'-\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}y',\ y=\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}x'+\frac{\sqrt{2}}{2}y'$ and collect terms to obtain $\frac{x'^{2}}{2} - \frac{y'^{2}}{2} - 1 = 0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Complete the squares: $\frac{x'^{2}}{2} - \frac{y'^{2}}{2} = 1$. The graph is a hyperbola. The coordinate axes rotate while the geometric curve stays fixed.

en.label: Example 3

steps.title: Calculate and reason

questions.prompt: 将坐标轴作合适锐角旋转消去 $xy$ 项：$2 x^{2} + \sqrt{3} x y + y^{2} - 5 = 0$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 取 $\cot(2\theta)=(A-C)/B$，并在 $0<2\theta<180^\circ$ 内选择角度（半角均取正），得 $\cos\theta=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\ \sin\theta=\frac{1}{2}$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 再配方得到 $\frac{5 x'^{2}}{2} + \frac{y'^{2}}{2} = 5$。因此图像为椭圆。坐标轴旋转而原平面曲线保持不动。

en.prompt: Rotate the coordinate axes through a suitable acute angle to eliminate the $xy$ term: $2 x^{2} + \sqrt{3} x y + y^{2} - 5 = 0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Use $\cot(2\theta)=(A-C)/B$ and select $0<2\theta<180^\circ$; both half-angle values are positive. Thus $\cos\theta=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\ \sin\theta=\frac{1}{2}$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Substitute $x=\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}x'-\frac{1}{2}y',\ y=\frac{1}{2}x'+\frac{\sqrt{3}}{2}y'$ and collect terms to obtain $\frac{5 x'^{2}}{2} + \frac{y'^{2}}{2} - 5 = 0$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Complete the squares: $\frac{5 x'^{2}}{2} + \frac{y'^{2}}{2} = 5$. The graph is an ellipse. The coordinate axes rotate while the geometric curve stays fixed.

en.label: Example 5
